registered: before computing any OI signal (data: research_data/databento_extra/fut_stats_daily.parquet, ES / NQ settlement, volume, open interest per contract, 2010-06..2026-09)
why: open interest says whether a move is carried by new positions (conviction) or by closing ones (short covering / liquidation); the futures book has no positioning input at all (COT was weekly and failed in Gen119)
signal: per root (ES, NQ): total open interest = sum over outright contracts (roll-neutral); 5-trading-day changes of the front settlement-based return R5 and of total OI dOI5 (OI known after the session: signal on day t, position on day t+1). Position: +1 if R5 > 0 and dOI5 > 0 (new longs), -1 if R5 < 0 and dOI5 > 0 (new shorts), 0 when OI falls; held one day, equal weight ES / NQ, returns = futures_db.daily roll-safe returns, costs = futures_db.cost_frac per side on position changes
judge: futures-book entrant rule (scripts/fbook.build, no save): 2023-26 book >= 1.218 + 0.05 and neither 2010-17 nor 2018-22 lower; also reported: the sleeve alone by period and its appraisal vs ES/NQ buy-and-hold
